## Activity

During June 2019, Central Eye Clinic completed 183 retinal image captures. The activity recorded for the month reflects the images submitted for review and grading. The service maintained a clear record of completed captures, supporting routine monitoring of the clinic’s screening activity and the subsequent assessment process.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for review. Three captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.6 per cent. These images could not be assessed reliably and were recorded separately from images that proceeded through the grading process. The ungradable findings should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality assurance.

## Grading

Grading identified 35 referable results among the captures reviewed. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 3 days. This provides an overview of the time taken for images to move through the review process during June 2019. Overall, the recorded activity, image quality, and grading results provide the monthly operational position for Central Eye Clinic.
